analysis_rule: Canonical counted_pass=1/counted_fail=0, every excluded/missing/unscored=NULL; raw verifier rewards retained as evidence, never substituted for counts; filter a separate complete-pair set per contrast before API; no physical replacements executed.

frozen_refs.serving_engine: SGLang (actual G4 parity/runtime, not vLLM planning label)

runtime_source_commits.basis: round manifests checkout.commit + capture manifests eval_lab_commit agree per segment; steward index_row commit backticks agree (55366a45bf85 for g5r cells, b1619aa3e3f0 for g5r2/g5r3 cells)
runtime_source_commits.difference_note: source commit differs by segment (g5r vs g5r2/g5r3); recorded as observed, no extra requirement added

g5r3.owner_abbreviated_hash_note: owner-reported 1709 LF / SHA 343fe946 validated against FULL source bytes: full-file sha256 343fe946b3481ff1563a9f40dc403c887619a1a28bb85d17fac46a8d1725b3e8 over 152564684 bytes and 1709 newline records; abbreviated hash never trusted alone

primary_family.confidence_intervals: 95% approximate paired score, marginal descriptive; not exact and not family-wise

coverage_semantics.capture_complete_for_binary_API: Eligible paired cells have source-bound canonical verdicts and full successful-response wire/settlement coverage; this flag is not a claim about all hidden upstream provider operations or full-ATIF reconstruction.
coverage_semantics.usage: Reported usage from HTTP200 only; 54 HTTP503 provider usage UNKNOWN (not zero). Reasoning included in completion tokens, never added a second time.
coverage_semantics.usd: NULL for every self-hosted cell; proxy failed-charge zero is not zero provider usage or free GPU. Shared per-cell GPU estimates must never be summed.
coverage_semantics.clocks: Only Z/+offset physical-trial and lab-wrapper clocks used for duration/order. Naive aggregate-job native clock strings are never cast to UTC.
coverage_semantics.sealing: Capture files are byte/SHA-bound closed sources; capture manifests have no ended_at or seal marker.
